loinc_label: Dermatan sulfate [Moles/volume] in DBS
claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "Hurler syndrome".
context: diagnosis: Newborn screening for low alpha-L-iduronidase activity — Alpha-L-iduronidase (IDUA) activity is measured on the dried blood spot by tandem mass spectrometry, digital microfluidic fluorometry or a fluorometric plate assay; a low activity is the first-tier screening signal for MPS I in all its severities and does not by itself separate Hurler from the attenuated forms. Pseudodeficiency alleles are the dominant cause of a low screening activity, so programmes add a second tier on the same spot: IDUA sequencing, or quantification of the stored glycosaminoglycans dermatan sulfate and heparan sulfate, which stay normal in carriers and pseudodeficiency.

loinc_label: 3-Hydroxypalmitoylcarnitine (C16-OH) [Moles/volume] in DBS
claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "long chain 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency".
context: diagnosis: Newborn screening (dried blood spot long-chain 3-hydroxyacylcarnitines) — Population newborn screening detects LCHAD deficiency by tandem mass spectrometry of acylcarnitines in the dried blood spot, with 3-hydroxypalmitoylcarnitine (C16-OH) and 3-hydroxyoleoylcarnitine (C18:1-OH) as the primary markers. The screen does not distinguish isolated LCHAD deficiency from complete mitochondrial trifunctional protein deficiency or isolated long-chain 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase deficiency, which raise the same analytes; a positive screen is confirmed by enzyme activity in fibroblasts or lymphocytes and HADHA/HADHB testing, with plasma acylcarnitines as a supporting rather than confirmatory result. Urine organic acids can be normal and are not a suitable confirmatory test.

loinc_label: Mumps virus IgM Ab [Presence] in Serum
claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "mumps infectious disease".
context: diagnosis: Mumps serology — Serum mumps IgM is the usual serological confirmation, and a rise in mumps IgG between paired sera confirms some further cases. In people who have received mumps vaccine the IgM response may be absent or short-lived and acute-phase IgG titres can already be high, so a negative IgM does not exclude mumps and a significant IgG rise may not be detected; IgM detection was markedly lower in vaccinated than in unvaccinated cases, which is why virus detection is recommended alongside serology.

loinc_label: Methylmalonate [Moles/volume] in DBS
claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "methylmalonic acidemia".
context: diagnosis: Newborn screening — Detection of MMA via tandem mass spectrometry using elevated propionylcarnitine (C3) as the primary marker. A multicenter Chinese study demonstrated NBS-detected mut-type MMA patients had significantly lower mortality (12.5% vs 32.7%) and better outcomes (normal outcome 51.8% vs 15.7%) compared to clinically diagnosed patients.

loinc_label: Streptococcus pyogenes [Presence] in Specimen by Organism specific culture
claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "toxic shock syndrome".
context: diagnosis: Culture of the suspected focus and sterile sites — Blood, wound, and mucosal-site cultures are obtained. In streptococcal TSS Streptococcus pyogenes is frequently recovered from a normally sterile site, which is required for a confirmed case; in staphylococcal TSS blood cultures are often negative because the organism remains at a colonized surface while the toxin acts systemically. Where a staphylococcal isolate is recovered, nucleic acid testing of it for the TSST-1 gene is reported alongside the culture as part of microbiological confirmation.
